column2: The KINO TÄHTI cinema stands by the road, east of the MAATALOUS silos: a Finnish cinema from the 80s-90s, with its parking, lobby, counter and two screen rooms. On the map (M) it is the \"Cinema\" spot; in the cheats, /place cinema takes you there.
Look at an item on the counter: its price shows up. Left click buys it, from your wallet.
Ticket, 35 mk: valid all day, for both screen rooms.
Popcorn 12 mk, chips 8 mk, soda 9 mk, candy 6 mk: in hand, F takes a bite or a sip (hunger and thirst go down). The empty pack drops at the end.
The screen room doors are at the top of the steps, at the back of the lobby. With a ticket, left click to open; they close by themselves.
To sit, stand in front of a seat and crouch (C), like on one of the game's chairs. The other players see you seated.
It's 21 °C inside the cinema: a good place to warm up.
Buy a film reel at the Osuuskauppa s21 (49 mk, top shelf, next to the tapes).
Reel in hand, press R: IMPORT A VIDEO… picks a file on your PC (it is shared with every player), or paste a direct link to a video (.mp4) then SET THE LINK.
Go into a screen room: the projection booth opens at the back, on the room side. Look at the projector with the reel in hand and left click to load it.
Look at the projector: F starts or stops the show, hold F takes the reel out. The lights dim and everybody sees and hears the film at the same time.

YouTube, VK Video and Rutube don't give out their video file: their links don't play. You need a link ending in .mp4 (archive.org, your own server…). Each player streams the link themselves: they need the connection for it.
Reels on the projectors stay there when you save. Can be turned off like the other additions: Settings > Co-op > MWCoop additions, Cinema chip (the host's choice applies to everyone).
Film reels for the KINO TÄHTI cinema, 49 mk: top shelf, next to the tapes.
